page: Microsoft Azure E248s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv7 series, provisioned via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor configuration providing 248 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1888.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a memory allocation ratio of approximately 7.61 GB per virtual core, aimed at large-scale, enterprise in-memory computation.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local disk storage and zero dedicated GPU accelerators. Disk operations depend entirely on remote block volumes through its Premium Storage capability. Architectural tradeoffs reflect a focus on massive concurrent thread execution and vast RAM pools, while omitting bundled ephemeral storage and complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the E248s_v7 consolidates substantial computational and memory density into a single virtual host, mitigating the overhead associated with running multiple smaller nodes. It is suited for demanding workloads including enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale data analytics, SAP HANA deployments, relational database consolidation, and high-concurrency transaction processing systems.
description: Microsoft Azure E248s_v7 is a high-density, memory-optimized instance from the Esv7 series built on x86_64 Intel architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. Equipped with 248 dedicated vCPUs and 1888.0 GB of system RAM, it maintains an allocation ratio of 7.61 GB per virtual core. The instance includes no bundled local disks or GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage via its Premium Storage capabilities, and comes without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads requiring extreme core counts and large volatile memory pools, such as large-scale in-memory relational and non-relational database engines, massive data caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and complex transaction processing.
